info.title: ef-timelapse
info.description: Time-travel viewer for EF Core schema history: replay scaffolded model changes commit-by-commit from Git history, or replay migration files directly, in a browser UI.

options.name: --out
options.description: Write a self-contained HTML report.

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the scan/replay model as JSON.

options.name: --mode
options.description: auto, migrations, or git. Default: auto.

options.name: --limit
options.description: Limit Git mode to the latest n commits touching the target.

options.name: --diff
options.description: Git diff payload: none, summary, or full. Default: summary.

options.name: --max-diff-chars
options.description: Max inline diff/preview chars per file. Default: 20000.

options.name: --port
options.description: Port for the local served viewer. Default: 5057.

options.name: --watch
options.description: In serve mode, rebuild the report after target-file changes.

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Disable the on-disk application cache index in Git mode; always re-walk full Git history.

options.name: --portable
options.description:
With --out: strip the absolute local target path and commit author
names from the report, and omit inline source diffs regardless of
--diff (overrides --diff full). Use this before sharing a report
outside your team. Off by default.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show help.
The target can be a Migrations folder or a project/data folder containing one obvious Migrations child.
Auto mode uses migrations when present, otherwise Git scaffold history when the target is inside a Git repository.
`serve` uses the same auto-detection: one command works for either mode, and always opens the
interactive viewer (the Git-mode served UI, or the self-contained migration report) at the given port.
If no output option is supplied, JSON is written to stdout.
